jobs.title: M&A Analyst
jobs.location: Austin, Texas, New York, New York
jobs.description:
About Us

- Insurance brokers sit at the intersection of care, cost, and access — yet remain one of the most underleveraged assets in the $5T healthcare value chain. They guide millions of Americans through plan selection, coverage questions, and care navigation, yet still rely on spreadsheets, manual workflows, and outdated tools that limit their growth and impact.

- Gyde is reimagining this. We’re building the first AI-native insurance brokerage platform—a system that learns from every client interaction to automate operations, power intelligent voice and chat experiences, and predict the right coverage and products for every individual or business.

- Our approach combines acquisition and AI: we acquire traditional brokerages and transform them into next-generation, data-driven organizations. Through Gyde’s platform, agencies run more efficiently, serve clients more personally, and scale faster than ever before.

- Join us if you’re excited to:

- Redefine how millions of people access and understand their healthcare coverage, by building systems that turn unstructured data, human conversations, and fragmented processes into intelligence.

- Build AI systems that improve how people access healthcare

- Design production-grade voice, chat, and predictive models for a highly regulated domain

- Launch technologies that augment human judgment and make complex decisions transparent and scalable

- Help reinvent an entire industry from the inside out

- We’re creating the future of brokerage — where every interaction, insight, and decision is powered by intelligence.

- Our founding team boasts pedigrees from Oscar, Stripe, Vista Equity Partners, and Alpine. Lightspeed led Gyde’s $60M financing, with participation from Optum Ventures , Crystal Venture Partners , Virtue , MVP Ventures , and multiple endowment funds, among others. Hear why on LSVP Investment Memo .

Role Summary

We’re looking for an M&A Analyst to power the analysis behind every brokerage Gyde evaluates, acquires, and closes.

Acquisitions are the engine of Gyde’s growth. Every agency we bring onto the platform starts as a set of seller financials, a book of business, and a handful of carrier statements. The quality of our analysis determines what we pay, how we structure the deal, and whether we should do it at all. As Gyde scales its acquisition pace across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employee benefits, and wholesale distribution, the speed and rigor of that analysis becomes one of the highest-leverage levers in the company.

You’ll sit at the center of the deal team. You’ll turn messy seller data into clean financials, build the EBITDA bridges and valuation models that set our price, and write the analysis that goes into our investment committee memos. You’ll coordinate diligence requests and third-party workstreams, keep the live deal pipeline accurate, and help build the AI-assisted tooling that lets a small team evaluate far more deals than a traditional corporate development function could.

This role is ideal for an analytically rigorous early-career professional from investment banking, private equity, corporate development, transaction advisory, or strategy consulting who wants real ownership on live deals. You’re as comfortable reconciling a carrier commission statement line by line as you are pressure-testing a seller’s adjusted EBITDA and forming a point of view on what a business is actually worth.

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain the financial models behind every deal, including EBITDA bridges, quality-of-earnings adjustments, valuation, sources and uses, and returns

- Spread and normalize seller financials, tax returns, and carrier commission statements into one clean, defensible set of numbers

- Pressure-test seller addbacks and revenue quality, including owner compensation, one-time items, carrier concentration, renewal versus new business, and producer dependency

- Draft the analysis, charts, and recommendations that go into investment committee memos, and help shape deal structure (earnouts, rollover equity, and retention)

- Screen inbound and outbound targets against Gyde’s acquisition criteria, and keep the live deal pipeline and deal trackers current and accurate

- Run diligence request lists end to end across financial, legal, compliance, and tax workstreams, tracking open items and chasing sellers for what is missing

- Coordinate with third-party advisors on Quality of Earnings, tax, and legal diligence, and translate their findings into model and structure changes

- Support signing and closing: purchase agreement schedules, working capital, funds flow, and closing checklists

- Build and improve the AI-assisted workflows, templates, and scorecards that make Gyde’s deal process faster and more repeatable

- Hand off clean deal data and context to the Value Creation team so every acquired agency starts integration with a clear baseline

What you bring / core competencies

- 1-3 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, corporate development, transaction advisory / Quality of Earnings, or strategy consulting

- Strong command of accounting and financial statements, and the ability to build a three-statement or deal model from a blank spreadsheet

- Command of the mechanics: EBITDA normalization, addbacks, valuation multiples, debt and equity financing, and returns analysis (MoM and IRR)

- Exposure to insurance distribution, brokerage, or healthcare services preferred; familiarity with commission-based revenue models a plus

- A practical, daily user of AI tools who knows how to get reliable output from them while retaining human judgement

- Meticulous attention to detail; your numbers tie, your sources are cited, and your assumptions are labeled

- Clear, concise writer who can turn a complex analysis into a recommendation a decision-maker can act on

- Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership; you want to run the work, not just support it

- Able to manage multiple live deals and competing deadlines without dropping the details

- Ability to travel up to ~10% for seller meetings and on-site diligence

What we offer

Gyde offers a competitive benefits package to all employees.

- $100,000-120,000 Base Salary + Equity

- Flexible (Unlimited) Paid Time Off

- Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

- Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K)

- Parental Leave

Hear why on LSVP Investment Memo .

Role Summary

As a Growth Marketing Associate at Gyde, you will be responsible for executing and supporting high-impact marketing initiatives that drive awareness, engagement, and demand for partnership with Gyde amongst agency principals and brokers. You’ll manage day-to-day marketing operations, from digital campaigns to events, and collaborate across teams to bring Gyde’s brand and value proposition to life while influencing the pipeline all year long. You’ll also develop sourcing team enablement materials, help welcome newly acquired agencies to Gyde, and support employee benefit agencies in our portfolio in their go to market motion.

This role is ideal for a versatile marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys being hands-on with tools and platforms, and is excited to build scalable marketing programs from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

- Drive Top of Funnel awareness: Produce video and blog content, social media, newsletters and other activations to ensure that all the right prospects have heard of Gyde, know what we do, and how we can help them grow into their next chapter. Build SEO and AEO foundations to ensure efficient discovery long term.

- Nurture and convert in the mid-funnel: Develop resources, email journeys, and landing pages to encourage the right prospective partners to connect with our sourcing team.

- Activate IRL to build relationships: Help the team build and strengthen relationships with prospects through event sponsorships, owned events, and webinars. Develop effective playbooks for exhibits, collateral, swag, and vendor management to consistently drive measurable ROI.

- Manage the Gyde Partner Experience from LOI through close and beyond, you’ll surround the Gyde Partners with regular branded touchpoints throughout their journey, including swag, communications, co-branding, Town Hall support, and regular touchpoints with Gyde’s Leadership.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sourcing, M&A, Partner Growth, Product, and People teams to ensure marketing initiatives align with company priorities and growth goals.

- Portfolio Support: Work closely with portfolio agencies with similar go to market needs, including sales enablement, event activation, etc.

KPIs and Outcomes

Success in this role is measured on the consistency, quality, and pipeline impact of Gyde's marketing engine, including:

- Top of Funnel Engagement: We’ll measure reach, frequency, and engagement to ensure prospects in target markets are seeing our messages often enough to take action.

- Campaign Execution: Campaigns and journeys shipped on schedule, with clear performance reporting on open, click, and reply rates and a documented test-and-learn cadence.

- Digital Presence: Website messaging refinement and other optimizations drive measurable improvement in time per session, pages per visit, and conversion on priority pages.

- Social Growth: Consistent publishing cadence on social media, especially Linkedin, with growth in followers, engagement rate, and inbound interest from target audiences.

- Event Impact: Events executed on time and on budget, measured on qualified conversations generated, cost per conversation, and follow-up completed within one week.

What You Bring and Who You Are

- 2–4 years of marketing experience, preferably in a growth-stage startup or B2B SaaS environment.

- Hands-on experience with Webflow (or similar CMS), social media tools, design tools like Figma and Canva, and marketing automation platforms like Hubspot or Ortto.

- Strong project management skills; you can juggle multiple workstreams and meet deadlines.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a sharp eye for effective copy and design.

- Analytical and data-oriented mindset; comfortable with reporting, testing, and using data to tell a story.

- A self-starter with a builder’s mindset–you thrive in ambiguity and enjoy creating structure.

- Collaborative and team-oriented; you’re energized by working cross-functionally.

- Familiarity with healthcare, insurance, or financial services is a plus, but not required.

What Makes You Successful in This Role

- Fluency with AI tools in your daily workflow; you use them to draft, test, and iterate faster rather than as a novelty.

- Effective marketing to non-technical, relationship-driven audiences — brokers, agency owners, small business owners — where trust matters more than jargon.

- Comfort working within brand and compliance guardrails in a regulated industry, and moving quickly anyway.

What we offer

Gyde offers a competitive benefits package to all employees.

- $115,000-135,000 Base Salary

- Flexible (Unlimited) Paid Time Off

- Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

- Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K)

- Parental Leave

Role Summary

We’re looking for a Partner Growth Director to drive growth, retention, and operational excellence across Gyde’s portfolio of health insurance agency partners.

As an account lead, you’ll own the long-term success of 3-5 asset acquisitions post-close. You’ll guide them through integration, drive adoption of Gyde’s platform, and lead the execution of Gyde’s Partner Growth initiatives. You’ll work cross-functionally with M&A, Marketing, Engineering, Finance, and HR to turn strategy into results.

This role is ideal for a top decile, generalist operator who loves tackling complex, ambiguous problems, enjoys building relationships, and thrives in a fast-moving environment. They’re equally comfortable problem-solving with leadership as they are executing autonomously with detail and precision.

You’ll be the connective tissue between Gyde’s leadership team and its agency partners, turning business plans into tangible outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

- Serve as the primary post-acquisition lead for agencies in integration and early growth phases

- Own the relationship with, and be accountable for performance of 3-5 partner agencies

- Develop and execute agency-specific Partner Growth plans spanning financial, operational, and growth initiatives

- Lead special projects that improve Gyde’s integration and Partner Growth engine as the company scales

- Coordinate all workstreams (systems, compliance, finance, HR, broker enablement/recruitment, go-to-market) to deliver seamless integration

- Build trust with agency owners and brokers, acting as their main point of contact and internal advocate

- Monitor key metrics (e.g., growth, retention, productivity, margin uplift, and platform adoption) and use data to drive continuous improvement

- Partner with Forward Deployed Specialists and internal teams to translate field learnings into scalable playbooks

- Act as “Voice of the Customer” for partner agencies internally across product, engineering, operations, finance and client teams

What you bring and who you are

- 4-6 years of experience at a top consulting or private equity firm driving portfolio operations

- Strong project management and analytical skills; experience running multi-workstream projects or post-merger integrations preferred

- Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills. Able to build trust and influence stakeholders from agency owners to internal execs

- A bias toward action; thrives when solving problems in real time

- High adaptability and composure in fast-changing environments

- Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership; comfortable working in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists

- Experience in insurance, healthcare, or brokerage operations is a plus but not required

- Ability to travel ~25% required

- Flexible (Unlimited) Paid Time Off

- Hybrid Work in Austin or NYC

- Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family
